# Graduate programme deadline tracker

Claude keeps this up to date during `/job-search` and `/review`. Big graduate programmes open in clusters (in Ireland, many Big-4/bank/insurer programmes open in **September** and close **mid-to-late October**), and some allow **only one application per firm**.

Before adding a programme, check:
- **Graduation-year eligibility:** many "2027" programmes want people *graduating in 2027*.
- **Start date:** usually September of the programme year.
- **One-application-only rules.**
